label: bug
file: src/notifications/rollup.ts

The code in src/notifications/rollup.ts sends the weekly summary email at 8 AM local time on the first day of the user's week as determined by the timezone. Since Australia/Sydney is ahead of UTC, if the server time triggering this is UTC-based or not properly adjusted, users in Sydney might get their Monday summary arriving on Tuesday morning UTC time but Monday local time. The logic in isRollupDue checks the local hour and compares timestamps to the start of the week which should respect time zones, but perhaps the server time used is not synchronized correctly with the user timezone handling. Investigation should focus on how 'now' is determined when sendWeeklyRollups is called and whether time zone conversions fully respect the user's configured timezone.
